input_contract.description: One approved action at a time, as chosen by the customer at the consent phase.

output_contract.description: A truthful result row. mb_freed is measured, never estimated.

observation_contract.description: The referent channel for relational semiotics. The Custodian stage (prontopc-custodian-stage) SUBSCRIBES to these events and may only change scene / fire a completion stroke in response to one - never on a timer. This is what makes U1 and U4 structurally enforceable rather than a matter of discipline.

evidence_contract.description: Result rows are saved into the locally generated Desktop report. The former Cloud Run /api/submit-repair-results evidence path is retired by the one-time paid Store app pivot.

working_parameters.outside_parameters_behavior: Unknown action id -> status:noted, no system change. Any exception -> status:error with the message; never a silent success.
